messages.author: 085b00b73e467d88
messages.subject: Re: MaxQtoMSstatsFormat: SILAC question
parts:
Hi Klemens,

MSstats does not support experiments with SILAC. The function MaxQtoMSstatsFormat() only considers DDA data format. This is the reason that it takes information from the Intensity column rather than Intensity.L or Intensity.H, as you also noted. 

Hope this clarifies some of your questions.
Tsung-Heng
